Title: Easy Halloween hairstyles for girls: ears, a tail or a bun in ten minutes
Description: Easy Halloween hairstyles for kids, made from simple styles: space buns for cat, bear or mouse ears, a bubble ponytail for a tail, and a top knot for a ballerina bun. Each one takes 5 to 10 minutes and is written for anyone who hasn't done much hair. See the finished looks and what each one needs on Dad Hair Hero, with the full steps in the app's optional style pack. Free app for iPhone and Android, no ads, no account.
